Messages.Author: Darkelf
Messages.Body:
Do the cards that state "Requires ready Prince or Justicar" need you to play
them on a Prince or Justicar or you just need to have one of them controlled
in order to use those cards?

For example:

You have Volker, the Puppet Prince and Bianca both controlled and tapped.
Your prey tries to equip with a leather jacket.

Could Bianca use The Second Tradition to untap and get the +2 intercept to
block the equip action?

In the Jyhad version of the card it just says "Prince or Justicar", no way
to confuse yourself, only them can play it, but as the vampire version says
"requires ready prince or justicar" it is not clear for us.

Thanks in advance

Darkelf

Messages.Author: Brian Reed
Messages.Body:
Prince / Justicar cards can only be played by Princes or Justicars....
In your example, only Volker could untap & block with 2nd.
However, Volker could play a 5th Tradition w/ Bianca as the target.
-Brian

Darkelf wrote:

> Do the cards that state "Requires ready Prince or Justicar" need you to play
> them on a Prince or Justicar or you just need to have one of them controlled
> in order to use those cards?

The minion playing a minion card must meet all the requirements of that
minion card, including discipline, clan, sect, capacity, and title.
